purpose: Collection artifact and retention contract; not an execution, acceptance or study-admission receipt

scope.additional_targets: Require independent adapter and artifact verification

coordinates.paths: Canonical relative POSIX paths within the pinned upstream source snapshot
coordinates.source_identity: SHA256 of exact source bytes; no whitespace or newline normalization
coordinates.candidate_unit: One row per path/module/anchor line, with all constituent site_spans retained
coordinates.ast_identity: Source-hash-bound path and per-file index; parent_index is per file
coordinates.scoring: Not selected by this contract; retain line and constituent-span representations

companion.provenance_limit: Manifest integrity and payload rederivation do not attest real native execution

private_retention: Sealed validation sources, compile/run stdout/stderr, verdicts, command records and original/restored proofs
Case index, fingerprint, manifest, human reviews and acceptance/proposal/label lineage
Unchanged existing testbench/checker/collateral and exact source/config/tool/implementation references
Complete capture work directory, both raw buggy logs, original and observed testbench, compiled timebase input and command records
Immutable companion including full raw VCD, all supported memory words, AST, graph, candidates, reset/checkpoint/time mappings and provenance
All six exports and private linkage to the exact case, companion and frozen specification store
All-outcome batch/collection/review/feedback ledgers and explicit missingness/completeness reports

missingness.unsupported: Explicit reason/status, never inferred zero or successful support
missingness.coverage: Unavailable for current crypto manifests; no measured RTL coverage or Ochiai claim
missingness.memory: One static unpacked dimension; up to 4096 explicit words by current observer default; unsupported shapes/ranges stay partial
missingness.time: Integer VCD ticks plus recorded resolution and compiled testbench exponents; no inferred nanoseconds or delta-cycle causality

admission.artifact_complete_requires: All required artifacts and links, exact-byte source identity, complete mappings/parity/windows, genuine retained execution provenance, six strict same-case exports, fixed specs and leakage checks
admission.partial_artifacts: May be retained with explicit missingness; cannot satisfy full-contract artifact completeness
admission.runtime_enforcement: Individual validators remain authoritative; the catalog is not runtime policy. Agent collection/readiness now require an externally hash-bound capture-execution-1 proof, retained raw work, bounded command history and rederived complete capture alongside six same-case exports. A trusted guarded caller is required; local files do not cryptographically attest physical execution. Complete recovery and live authorization remain separate gates.
